name: Sputtervalve
summary: Under pressure in Ratchet, Sputtervalve races to finish shredder research for the Tinkers' Union. Director Riddlevox holds him to crushing deadlines, and he hires adventurers to steal designs from the rival Venture Company.

sections.title: Industrial Pressure
sections.body: In Ratchet, Sputtervalve answers to Director Riddlevox of the Tinkers' Union. The goblin engineer oversees shredder development and has found the work brutal. Modern mechanization moves fast, the Venture Company presses hard, and his own prototypes are few. With the deadline closing in, Sputtervalve fears admitting failure to the Union. He turns to a familiar goblin practice: stealing better designs from those who built them first.

sections.title: Eyes on the Venture Company
sections.body: The Venture Company's drilling operation at the Sludge Fen, to the northwest, is Sputtervalve's chief target. Its latest shredders have interchangeable hands, refined control grips, and advanced inner workings, including the elusive samophlange. Sputtervalve sent his associate Wizzlecrank into the Fen for field research, but Wizzlecrank became trapped. Now Sputtervalve hires wandering mercenaries to recover the stolen technology and rescue his partner.

sections.title: A Fixer in Ratchet
sections.body: Sputtervalve also helps with strange curiosities that pass through the Barrens. Adventurers sometimes bring him bizarre artifacts infused with corruption from the Wailing Caverns, such as a glowing shard. He knows the local landscape well enough to point them away from machinery and toward the isolated druids encamped above the caverns.

faq.answer: Sputtervalve is a goblin engineer in Ratchet and a member of the Tinkers' Union. Director Riddlevox put him in charge of shredder research and development, and he scrambles to meet the strict deadlines.

faq.q: Why is Sputtervalve targeting the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is building advanced shredders at the Sludge Fen, with interchangeable hands and refined control grips. Unable to match their designs, Sputtervalve turns to espionage to steal their plans and machinery.
A samophlange is an advanced mechanism found inside Venture Company shredders. Sputtervalve hires adventurers to retrieve and examine one so he can learn their technology.
Wizzlecrank is Sputtervalve's associate and operative. Sent into the Sludge Fen for field research, Wizzlecrank became trapped, so Sputtervalve hires help to recover him and the stolen technology.

faq.q: Why does Sputtervalve care about the Glowing Shard?
faq.answer: Sputtervalve does not study organic curiosities, but he knows the Barrens well. When shown the shard recovered from the Wailing Caverns, he directs adventurers to the druids encamped above the caves.
Director Riddlevox leads the Tinkers' Union. He put Sputtervalve in charge of shredder innovation and holds him to strict production deadlines.

angles.text: Sputtervalve shows the ruthless side of goblin engineering: when invention stalls, take the schematics from a rival.
Ratchet is neutral, but Sputtervalve depends on Horde travelers crossing the Barrens to disrupt Venture Company operations and smuggle machine parts.
